subject: HelioMed: SE demo coordination and procurement/security checklist
messages:

Subject: Intro + proposed SE demo slots (HelioMed)

Alex / Priya — great to e-meet. Thanks for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to schedule a 45-minute technical demo with Solutions Engineering and your engineering/security folks to walk through: deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private), network & key management options, and an initial SLO/cost profile for your batch inference workload.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 8, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Jun 9, 13:00–13:45
- Thu Jun 10, 16:00–16:45

Please reply with preferred slot and any additional attendees (security, infra, procurement). Karthik and Soojin will run the demo; I’ll handle logistics and follow-ups.

Attachments: high-level SE deck (redwood_se-deck.pdf).

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Intro + proposed SE demo slots (HelioMed)

Marissa — thanks. Wed Jun 9 at 13:00 PT would be best for our engineering team (James and I). A few notes from procurement/security so we can come prepared:

- Procurement (Priya): we’ll need a preliminary SOW/PO outline and estimated monthly committed spend to evaluate internal approvals.
- Security (James): please bring a SOC2 summary and an explanation of data retention & audit logging. Also clarify whether the Private deployment option supports customer-managed KMS.

If you can include those items in advance, we’ll be able to include our security engineer on the call.

—Alex
Director of Engineering, HelioMed

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@heliomed.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <procurement@heliomed.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed SE demo slots (HelioMed)

Thanks Alex — Wed Jun 9, 13:00 PT works for us. Quick notes so we’re all aligned before the demo:

1) Attendees: please confirm if James (security) and Priya (procurement) will join. If procurement cannot join live, a PO/contact person will suffice.

2) Materials I’ll bring to the call (attached):
- SOC2 summary (SOC2-summary-2025.pdf)
- Infra diagram (redwood_infra-arch.png) showing VPC/private option and KMS wiring
- Rough committed-cost scenarios for 3 workload profiles (we’ll present these during the demo)

3) Access and pre-demo ask from engineering: if you want us to load a small sample model into your VPC trial or test cluster later, we’ll need sandbox network details and a short-lived service account. Not required for the demo; we can make it a next step.

4) Timing: we’ll allocate 30 minutes for the technical walkthrough and 15 minutes for procurement/security Q&A. If you have a particular compliance checklist, send it over and Soojin will pre-answer the highest priority items.

I’ll send a calendar invite shortly and include the meeting link + pre-reads.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf, redwood_infra-arch.png

Subject: Re: Intro + proposed SE demo slots (HelioMed)

Karthik / Marissa — thanks for confirming. Two procurement items to flag ahead of the demo so the finance team can accelerate: 

- Can you provide a one-page pricing band (commit tiers + overage rates) for Hosted API and Dedicated? We don’t need exact numbers in the demo but a ballpark helps.
- Please include an estimate for a 12-month committed capacity scenario tied to the cost examples you’ll show.

If everything looks good after the demo, I’ll request a standard PO and follow the DocuSign route. I’ve copied our legal contact on a separate thread for T&Cs; we’ll surface any redlines after the demo.

—Priya
Head of Procurement, HelioMed
